title: Understanding the Log-Odds
text: Recall that the log-odds is the logarithm of the odds ratio, which is the ratio of the probability of an event occurring to the probability of it not occurring.

title: Linear Relationship in Logistic Regression
text: In logistic regression, we assume that the log-odds of the probability is a linear function of the input features.

title: Log-Odds Linear Assumption
text: Is the assumption that the log-odds is linear always true in logistic regression?
